tiers.why: D-011: hobby launch, small product, growing product, breakout; receipt shows 10k

daily_active_ratio.why: DAU/MAU of 20-30% is typical for retained consumer apps; upper end so usage is not understated

messages_per_active_user_per_day.why: a short daily chat session; base rate for per_message and per_keystroke sites

page_views_per_active_user_per_day.why: a short daily visit: home, app, 2-3 navigations; base rate for per_page_view and per_render sites

polls_per_active_user_per_day.why: polling once a minute over ~20 minutes of daily use; aggressive_polling multiplies this

cron_runs_per_active_user_per_day.why: a daily job that does one call per active user (digest); a fixed job that does not loop over users costs far less, lower it

webhooks_per_active_user_per_day.why: one inbound event (message, form, payment) per active user per day

signups_per_active_user_per_day.why: about 9% of users are new each month (0.01 x 30 days x 30% active)

default_input_tokens.why: system prompt plus a few turns of context, used when a call site gives no estimate

default_output_tokens.why: a 1-2 paragraph reply, used when a call site gives no estimate

emails_per_user_per_month.why: welcome, sign-in link, a receipt and one notification

storage_mb_per_user.why: a few uploaded photos or documents (~4 x 5 MB) per user

db_mb_per_user.why: ~90 messages/user/month (0.3 x 30 x 10) x ~2 KB per row incl. indexes, kept about a year

egress_mb_per_active_user_per_day.why: a few dozen API/database JSON responses of ~100 KB per active day

bandwidth_mb_per_page_view.why: median page weight is ~2 MB but repeat views are mostly browser-cached

paying_user_ratio.why: freemium conversion is typically 2-5%; upper end so payment fees are not understated

avg_payment_usd.why: your own price per payment (not a vendor price); a common entry subscription, edit to yours

chars_per_message.why: a short typed question; keystroke_llm_call fires once per character

render_loop_multiplier.why: a call in a render or effect loop typically fires ~5x per view (state updates, StrictMode double render)

history_input_multiplier.why: resending full history over a ~10-turn chat averages ~4x the single-turn input

no_prompt_cache_multiplier.why: ~30% of requests repeat an earlier prompt (retries, reloads, identical questions) and could be served from an app cache

poll_seconds.why: generated UIs usually poll every 2-10 s; aggressive_polling multiplies by 60 / poll_seconds

uploads_per_user_per_month.why: a profile photo plus an occasional image

image_variants.why: a responsive image is requested at ~4 widths (phone, tablet, laptop, desktop)

select_all_egress_multiplier.why: select('*') typically returns ~3x the columns a screen needs
